input.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts) - julianday(s.shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_joined, SUM(CASE WHEN datetime(o.order_ts, '+8 hours') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unparsed_ts FROM orders o JOIN shipments s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE s.shipped_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL

final_answer.basis: 依語意層的時區規則，將 orders.order_ts（UTC）加 8 小時換算為台北時間後，篩選 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的訂單。配送天數定義為 shipments.delivered_ts 減 shipped_ts（以天為單位），排除任一時間為空的紀錄，共 9,921 筆；所有訂單時間皆可解析，且無 delivered 早於 shipped 的紀錄。
